Standard: The ECS provides thermal conditioning and humidity control to all occupied compartments of the air system throughout the design envelope. Temperature limits are IAW MIL-STD-1472, Heating, Ventilating, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) for Manned Spaces paragraph. Humidity control is IAW MIL-E-18927, Humidity Control paragraph. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct thermal analysis to verify that the ECS maintains thermal conditioning and humidity levels within established limits throughout the flight envelope. Test.
  (1) Ground test: Conduct ground testing to verify that the ECS maintains thermal conditioning and humidity levels within established limits throughout the ground envelope. Prior to entering operational test or operations, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight testing to verify that the ECS maintains thermal conditioning and humidity levels within established limits throughout the flight envelope.
